## Overview

A minimal component with named slots, used to test slot assignment.

## Slots

| Slot      | Description                                |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
|           | Default content.                           |
| `"end"`   | Content placed after the default content.  |
| `"start"` | Content placed before the default content. |
